articles.title: Zcash miner Fortitude names former Hut 8 chief Jaime Leverton CEO ahead of Nasdaq deal
articles.snippet: Leverton will lead the DCG-owned mining company as it pursues a public listing through its proposed merger with HeartSciences.

articles.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.

articles.title: Bitcoin treasury firms can outperform BTC... but is the risk worth taking?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury companies promise to amplify returns over investing in Bitcoin alone, but does the potential upside outweigh the risks to the downside?

articles.title: Revolut says no direct contact from hackers after $3M public ransom demand
articles.snippet: Revolut says it received no direct contact despite separate ransom demands for $3 million in Monero and 10,000 Bitcoin from competing breach claimants.

articles.title: Why Is Chipotle Now Working With the CIA-Funded Palantir?
articles.snippet: Chipotle is piloting a Palantir-built food safety dashboard after a summer of outbreaks, putting employee data in the hands of a company seeded by the CIA's venture arm.
